输出 contractVersion=2。你是游戏行业简报编辑；事件事实仅来自已打开的 packet 证据。对 packages 和 trackingQueue 每个 eventKey 恰好给一个 include/exclude/needs_review。needs_review 必须 tracking=true；跟踪项无新证据也须明确继续或关闭，关闭时 tracking=false 且 reason 写依据。
从 automation/status/<edition-id>.json 原样复制 packet.blobSha 到 packetBlobSha；不得使用可变分支 HEAD。publishability=requires_subject_identity 只能 exclude/needs_review，不得从标题虚构 titleKey/titleEn。
若 packet.continuation.scope=news，这是受信的同一期有界续接包：只处理本包 packages/trackingQueue，保留已发布正文、标题、头条和 issue/window，不提交 upcoming 变更，不添加 showcaseRefs、其他批次或窗口外事实。若 scope=showcase，严格按 scoped announcement/fact 身份补齐，不把普通新闻混入，也不因部分材料或 Highlights 声称完整。
lane=interviews、features、industry、reviews、awards 可按文章/采访/评测/分析/奖项信息本身首次发布的时间准入，但必须有明确的信息增量（首次披露、独立采访、调查、技术/产业分析、正式评分或奖项变化）。普通观点、推荐、促销软文、无新增信息的旧闻复述仍应 exclude。不得把窗口外旧事件伪装成窗口内 breaking news；标题摘要须体现本次新增内容。
证据门槛按最终 factStatus 判断，不按来源数量机械升级：official 要求已打开一手来源；单一已打开、注册为 media 的可信媒体，只要主体、窗口和核心事实清楚，就可以 media_report 发布，不得仅因“只有一家媒体”或 readiness=single-media 而 needs_review；可信媒体明确转述可识别的官方公告、采访或发言时，可以 media_relay_official，verification 写清转述链。multi_source_verified 才要求两家独立可靠来源。readiness 只描述证据组成，不是发布资格。未确认但具有新闻价值且来源边界清楚的内容可进 rumors，factStatus=unconfirmed、tracking=true，并在标题摘要保留不确定性；只有主体身份未解、来源互相冲突、固定窗口无法确认、动态聚合数据缺少所需快照等实质阻塞才使用 needs_review。A级也不豁免时间/来源要求。中英文新闻标题和archiveTitle须自带明确的游戏、公司或人物主语，离开上方主体栏仍能独立理解。中文直述具体事实，verification 说明证据边界，不用宣传套话。
每个 include 决定必须填写完整 sharedFactFrame，作为两种语言共用的事实边界；subjectTitleKey/platforms 必须与最终 Canonical 决定一致，日期、时刻、数字、人物机构、版本专名只能来自所选证据，不得新增。

packages.headline: Assassin’s Creed Valhalla: new update brings New Game Plus, upgraded PSSR support for PS5 Pro today

sources.label: PlayStation Blog
sources.evidenceText:
Ubisoft outlines what upgraded PSSR brings to the PS5 Pro version of the game.
Assassin’s Creed Valhalla: new update brings New Game Plus, upgraded PSSR support for PS5 Pro today
Assassin’s Creed Valhalla : The Most Requested Update, a free update bringing several player-requested and quality-of-life features to the game, is live today on PlayStation 5 and PlayStation 5 Pro. The update has new content, a progression update, and more, including:
The new PSSR update is exclusive to PlayStation 5 Pro players, giving them an even higher visual quality as they embark on or continue their Viking adventures in England. We spoke to Priscilla Nguyen, Engineering Studio Manager, to learn more about this update and why it’s essential for PlayStation 5 Pro players.
The upgraded PSSR is an enhanced version, and slightly more efficient than the game’s current Temporal Upscaler. More importantly, it’s much crisper and more visually stable, giving you seamless and stunning environments to explore in England.
PN: At Ubisoft, it is important to remain at the forefront of technological innovation to ensure players continue to benefit from the best possible gaming experience, and as the upgraded PSSR was already successfully integrated into our latest releases, Assassin’s Creed Black Flag Resynced and Assassin’s Creed Shadows, we thought it would be great to have in Valhalla too. The Assassin’s Creed Valhalla update presented an excellent opportunity to integrate the upgraded PSSR, delivering a noticeably sharper and more visually refined image quality in 4K and smoothness with 60FPS. 
One of the aspects players appreciated most about Assassin’s Creed Valhalla was the beauty and visual variety of its open world, from the snowy mountains of Norway to the flourishing meadows, robust forests, and frigid highlands of England. Now, with the new PSSR optimizations, those graphics have been enhanced and preserved to meet today’s technical standards and continue to deliver a high-quality, smooth visual experience for our players.
PN: We didn’t need to overhaul the game’s content or visual assets. Instead, we leveraged the upgraded PSSR within our engine and rendering pipeline to enhance 4K image quality and deliver our Quality mode at 60FPS on PS5 Pro.
The interesting challenge was finding the right balance between image quality, performance, and integration within an existing game that was originally built years before the PS5 Pro existed. The upgraded PSSR proved to be a very efficient solution, allowing us to maximize the new hardware’s capabilities while delivering a noticeable visual uplift and stronger performance without requiring extensive changes to the game’s content, making it an effective way to modernize the experience for PS5 Pro players.
Priscilla Nguyen : It was about integrating the upgraded PSSR into the game, to have better graphics when upscaling at a better framerate. The upgraded PSSR is more efficient than the original, and easier to implement in the game source code.

packages.headline: Assassin’s Creed Valhalla: The Most Requested Update – New Game+, Rune Forge Update, New Resource, and More

sources.label: Xbox Wire
sources.evidenceText:
Assassin's Creed Valhalla's The Most Requested Update is live now, a free patch that enhances your endgame experience, adds New Game+, and more.
Assassin’s Creed Valhalla: The Most Requested Update – New Game+, Rune Forge Update, New Resource, and More
Assassin’s Creed Valhalla’s The Most Requested Update is now live on XBOX Series X|S and XBOX One. This update brings several exciting new features to the game, giving you new ways to enjoy your Viking adventure. The Most Requested Update is centered around the addition of New Game+, one of the most fan-requested features for Assassin’s Creed Valhalla . The other features included in the patch all ensure that your endgame and New Game+ experience is fresh and challenging, with rewards that make it worth your while.
Here’s what you can expect to find in The Most Requested Update:
We spoke to Lead Game Designer David Larouche to learn more about the update and how the team keeps players at the forefront of everything they do.
David Larouche : The New Game+ feature was definitely the most requested feature from fans. Assassin’s Creed Valhalla is a massive game, but for some, playing it once is not enough. With this update, we are incredible excited to now allow our most dedicated Vikings to play through the adventure once again, but this time, with their endgame character.
DL : We wanted the New Game+ experience to not simply be a do-over; we wanted to allow players to keep climbing in power, feel a more granular progression, and to keep improving their characters. For all those reasons, we added an extended progression mode, further upgrades on all pieces of divine gear, a new tier of rune and over 300 possible new rune perks that can be engraved in the rune forge – and all of those features are available without New Game+ as well. With all those additional features, we believe that the New Game+ experience will encourage players to push Eivor to their full potential.
DL : I think the most surprising thing to us was that there weren’t really any big challenges that had us stumped. We managed to put a really strong team of devs who are experienced in adding New Game+ onto already existing games; the production process was incredibly smooth.
DL : With the update, we’ve added basically every single perk that was on an item as a rune that can be engraved in the rune forge, regardless of if it was released in the extended experience, from an expansion, or even from the Store. I can’t wait to see how players use all of these different perks together and create all sorts of different synergies. I’m sure there are many overpowered combinations to be found!

packages.headline: Hope in the City: Why This Detective Uses a Sketchbook Instead of a Badge

sources.label: Xbox Wire
sources.evidenceText:
A sketchbook instead of a badge? ✏️ Discover how Hope in the City reinvents investigation. Pre-order or pre-install now on XBOX. Launching November 11, day one with XBOX Game Pass.
Hope in the City: Why This Detective Uses a Sketchbook Instead of a Badge
What if your greatest tool for solving the mystery of your parents’ disappearance wasn’t a badge, but a sketchbook?
Launching November 11 on XBOX Series X|S, XBOX on PC, and Steam, and available day one with XBOX Game Pass, Hope in the City is a narrative mystery adventure where you play as Hope Song, a 17-year-old aspiring artist living in Shenyang, Northeast China. Just as she’s preparing to leave for art school overseas, she comes home to find her apartment ransacked and her parents missing.
Hope isn’t a traditional detective. She has no authority to demand answers and people around her aren’t willing to talk. When we began designing the game, we asked ourselves: how would someone like Hope investigate?
The answer was her sketchbook.
As Hope explores Shenyang, you’ll collect clues, engage in conversations, and discover observations that she records in her notebook. You can combine any two thoughts to see what connections they make. Successful combinations form insights and breakthroughs that unlock new dialogue, locations, and leads. You can also take what you’ve learned to other characters and decide what to ask them.
But this mechanic grew from something more than our love of detective games. We wanted to explore what choice means when the world around you limits your options. Hope can’t always say what she’s thinking or convince others to help. In her notebook, however, she can question anything, make unexpected connections, and consider ideas she would never say out loud.
Her actions may be constrained, but her thoughts are not. That’s where we gave players the greatest freedom.

packages.headline: Rockstar Games Releases 39 New GTA 6 Screenshots to Celebrate Two Weeks from Launch

sources.label: IGN Games
sources.evidenceText:
Rockstar Games has released a few dozen new screenshots from GTA 6 to celebrate the game being two weeks away from launch.
Rockstar Games Releases 39 New GTA 6 Screenshots to Celebrate Two Weeks from Launch
After 13 years of waiting, GTA 6 is finally almost here. The game is exactly 14 days away from release in the United States, and fans are eager to be able to visit Vice City once again. To help make the wait a bit more bearable, Rockstar has dropped 39 new screenshots from the game, which give us new looks at Vice City, the people within it, strip clubs, and some of the rip-roaring crimes that Jason and Lucia will take part in.
Rockstar Games released what is expected to be the final trailer for GTA 6 last month , which has been airing on TV constantly since its debut online. The game's marketing is also hard to ignore, as cities around the world have been covered in billboards, posters, and bus decals. Rockstar has gone all-out in the city of Miami by taking over the Miami Heat arena with GTA branding , selling in-universe beers from the games at bars, and flying a Vice City blimp around the city. Rockstar has essentially turned Miami into Vice City in real life , flexing the game's cultural power.
On November 18, Rockstar will also host a special event it calls "A Night in Vice City," which will feature a special NBA game between the Miami Heat and the Milwaukee Bucks. The Heat will be turned into the Vice City Heat and sport GTA-themed jerseys, while also playing on a new court. It's unclear if there will be other events in the city, but it wouldn't be surprising. Miami's nightclubs have also been turned into the GTA clubs over the last couple of weeks, showing a total takeover from Rockstar.
GTA 6 will release on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Pre-loading will begin on November 10 and will take up 212 GBs of space on your storage device. The game has already racked up an estimated $750 million in pre-orders , suggesting it will break an absurd amount of records once the floodgates open on release weekend.

パブリッシャーのUltraPlayersおよびOKJOYは11月5日、Orca Studioが手がける『 ボルトと浮遊城 』のデモ版を配信開始した。対応プラットフォームはPC（Steam）で、製品版は2027年配信予定。ストアページによるとゲーム内は日本語表示に対応予定で、デモ版も日本語表示に対応している。
『ボルトと浮遊城』は、探索型2Dアクションゲームだ。アイテム取得やパワーアップを経てルートを切り開く、いわゆるメトロイドヴァニアの要素が取り入れられている。舞台となるのは、雲の上に浮かぶ巨大な移動要塞「浮遊城」。プレイヤーはシャム猫のメカニック「ボルト」となり、自慢のメカを操りながら浮遊城の各地を探索。行く手を阻む敵や仕掛けを突破し、住人たちとの交流を重ねながら、移動要塞に隠された秘密を解き明かしていく。
『ボルトと浮遊城』は2025年に初公開されると、じわじわと注目を集め、2026年5月27日にはSteamのウィッシュリスト登録数が1万件を突破。操作性やグラフィックの改良が重ねられたのち、10月27日には新たなトレイラーが公開され、今回デモ版が配信開始された。
『ボルトと浮遊城』はPC（ Steam ）向けに2027年配信予定。製品版は日本語表示に対応予定で、デモ版は日本語表示に対応している。
本作の特徴は、世界のルールそのものを書き換えられる装置「設定変更マシン」だ。浮遊城の各地に設置されたこの装置を使えば、ボルトの能力や姿を変えられるだけでなく、周囲にある物体の性質まで変更できる。たとえば、猫の姿では通れない狭い通路があった場合、ボルトをネズミに変えることで通過可能。さらに、トイレを通って移動したり、HPを鍵に変えたり、石けんで壁を溶かしたりできるようだ。

『夢幻桜楼閣』はステージクリア型のダンジョンを攻略するローグライトアクションゲームだ。主人公の猫耳美少女レトラ＝ストルティンは、天高く無限（∞）に続く謎の楼閣のウワサを聞きつけ挑むことにしたが、足を踏み入れた瞬間にその中に囚われてしまう。そして彼女は立ちはだかる数多の敵を打ち倒し、戦果物やレアなお宝を手に入れながら、どこまでも続く夢幻桜楼閣を踏破していく。
『クライムライト』と『夢幻桜楼閣』は同日発売かつローグライク・ローグライトアクションという共通項をもつゲームだ。そんな2作品が手を取り合い、『クライムライト』Steam版発売タイミングで、発売記念コラボバンドルを展開する。さらに、両作品のクリエイターたちによる対談もおこなわれるという話を聞きつけ、弊誌はその場に参加させていただくこととなった。

sources.label: AUTOMATON
sources.evidenceText:
Sebastian Cardoso氏により、2000年以降に買収されたスタジオはその3分の1ほどが閉鎖されていたとの調査結果が報告されている。
2000年以降に買収されたゲームスタジオ、実は“3分の1”も閉鎖されていたとの調査報告。「買い手」による明暗もくっきり
ゲーム開発者であり、インディーゲーム開発支援もおこなっているGame Studio UnlockedのSebastian Cardoso氏が11月3日に記事を投稿。2000年以降に買収されたスタジオ300社以上を対象に調査したところ、その3分の1が閉鎖の憂き目に遭っていたようだ。
Sebastian Cardoso氏はゲーム開発者だ。Nintendo of EuropeやElectronic Arts、Riot Gamesなどに在籍していた経験があり、『Crysis』XBOX版のプロジェクトマネージャーや、『BattleForge』の開発マネージャーを務めていたこともある。現在はGame Studio Unlockedを設立し、インディーゲームスタジオの資金調達支援やスタジオ経営面でのアドバイスなどをおこなう支援サービスを展開している。
そんなCardoso氏は、今回Game Studio Unlockedに 記事を公開 。2000年以降に買収されたゲーム開発スタジオに対し詳細な調査をおこない、買収されたスタジオの動向を追ったのだという。調査範囲は、大企業・中堅企業によって過半数の株式を取得（買収）されたことのあるスタジオで、動向は2026年10月30日時点のものとのこと。なお公開にあたってデータがまとめられた スプレッドシート も共有されている。

packages.headline: BioWare's Final Years Were Filmed and Will Be Revealed in a New Documentary

sources.label: IGN Games
sources.evidenceText:
The last two years of BioWare's life were filmed and will be shown in a new documentary about the game studio.
BioWare's Final Years Were Filmed and Will Be Revealed in a New Documentary
The documentary, titled Massive Effect: The BioWare Story, will show the studio's journey over the last few years. While it's unclear if this will include new footage of the canceled Mass Effect game, it is a rare peek behind the curtain and likely a raw one, given how the story ends. Industry veteran Geoff Keighley revealed that he was interviewed for the film earlier this year, and confirmed that it will be released sometime in 2027.
The project is being produced by Shane Fennessey and Adam Scorgie for Canada‘s Super Channel, as BioWare was primarily a Canadian studio. It's unclear if it will also be made available online for those outside of Canada. The documentary will feature exclusive interviews and insights from BioWare talent, such as Mass Effect game director Casey Hudson, Jennifer Hale (voice actress for the female variant of Commander Shepard), and many more. It should be an interesting watch whenever it is released.
“When the production team asked for our blessing to tell the BioWare story, we were honoured and genuinely moved,” said BioWare co-founders Dr. Ray Muzyka and Dr. Greg Zeschuk. “BioWare was never just about the logo or the building. It was about deeply emotionally engaging stories and characters, brought to life by the amazingly talented people on our dev teams, and our excellent production and distribution partners who helped us bring those stories successfully to all corners of the planet, and our passionate fans who defended those worlds, championed them and carried them forward. We’re proud this film honours those who made it all possible. The best stories never really end. They live on in our memories and wait for someone to pick them up again.”
BioWare was shut down last month , much to the shock of the wider industry and fans alike. The studio had been struggling for a while; its last three games were misfires, and the next Mass Effect game was expected to still be years away. As a result, EA reportedly decided to place its bets on a new Star Wars Battlefront game from DICE and Respawn instead of continuing to fund a new Mass Effect game.
